{{Top|canon=Wrist comm}}
[[File:WristLink-E1Snap.png|thumb|right|250px|Darth Maul's wrist link]]
The multi-purpose '''wrist link''' (sometimes '''wristlink''' or '''wrist comm''') was a device worn on a being's wrist that usually incorporated a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with other equipment. A common feature to add was a [[Chronometer/Legends|chrono]].

==History==
[[File:Lando_TESB30.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lando Calrissian wearing a wrist link]]
[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] such as [[Darth Talon]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] were known to use such devices. Maul employed a wrist link that allowed him to arm [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] and traps, detonate explosives, receive signals from his [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droids]] and other surveillance gear, and to summon and direct his [[Bloodfin/Legends|speeder bike]].

[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were equipped with wrist links for use on the battlefield. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] received a transmission from [[Daakman Barrek]] while stationed on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Barrek reported the existence of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]].

Notable figures such as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] were also known to use them, as were [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] such as [[Arwen Cohl]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] had a wrist link in his [[gauntlet]]s which he used to detonate explosives and transfer all of a ship's primary functions into them.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used a wrist link during his patrol on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], to inform [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] that he would investigate what he [[Viper probe droid/Legends|believed to be a meteorite]] before reporting back to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].
